osm_qa.scope: Lightweight source transaction readiness before expensive capture; actual source-ID state and intact target component absence from residual data at near screenshots. Root visual review is still mandatory.

network.scope: Explicit Playwright BrowserContext proxy shared by browser requests, context.request and route.fetch; localhost remains direct.

network_fault_injection.scope: Known Overture tile/STAC service outage only. Native browser cache policy remains in effect; cache use is observed, not forced. No claim that this resolves a production network failure.

browser_proof.reason: Independent model delivery only; final static/catalog/LOD/owner browser acceptance remains with integration workflow.

geometry_proof.scope: 9,539Float32 parts closed/positive;378,504raw/web oriented position/material triangles match. Maximum normal deviation0.023652deg below existing0.05deg; LOD bounds change0.021613m. Isolated raw rebuild is byte-identical.

height_evidence.scope: Acceptance of disclosed photo-relative estimate21.55m with18.5–24m sensitivity range and no measured-height claim. The17.25m CNBH10m raster baseline is not tower height evidence.

identity_footprint.scope: Named current OSMw1085786138@2 exactly matched to existing GERS/local2557; original parallelogram preserved.9-macro independent linked-parts/ownership audit and10 retained neighbors. Not a cadastral survey.

roof.scope: Double curved tower eaves and continuous low wing slopes reviewed in final native;3,080 actual tile pairs/27,720 samples clear. Rear roof and absolute pitch remain declared estimates; fine sculpture simplified.

size_proof.scope: All four final files individually below100,000,000bytes; largest39,953,968byte editable native. GLBs self-contained and source attribution preserved.

source_photos.scope: Both original Commons JPEGs actually viewed, attributed and unchanged; CC BY-SA4.0, 2014 daylight/2024 appearance roles explicit.

texture_mapping_qa.scope: Actual raw/web/LOD have0images/0textures. No photograph, night lighting, tree/person or wall-shadow pixels are embedded. Material classes and stained glass are geometry/material estimates.

uncertainty.scope: Photos support documented visible facade, not scanned whole-building accuracy. Height/depth/wall thickness, hidden rear, roof intersections, materials/font and carved guardians are estimated/simplified. At independent model delivery HTML lifecycle remains pending.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Tower1entry/3middle/3upper openings, wing circles and mixed arched/rectangular glazing reviewed in final native. Actual raw/web/LOD297 masonry-interior samples plus negative controls; finite samples, not full boundary metrology.
